problems: Resume run 2026-10-24: all nine dossiers (six owned, three counterparts) had been completed on 2026-10-20 but the first run could not deliver its final pass, notes or report because the /mnt/project-files mount went down at about 01:43 UTC that day. This run validated every final version against the live mount tools (0 errors; the only gazetteer warnings are the 8 unknown regions of south-africa: Transkei, Bophuthatswana, Venda, Ciskei), copied the eight whose final versions differed (quote-hygiene edits to notes only) over the 01:24-01:40 drafts, kept italian-africa.json as it was, wrote history/polities/_notes/af-08-e.md and this report. No dossier was rewritten.

Accident, disclosed: during the resume run an independent rebuild of italian-africa (9 pages opened on 2026-10-24, 54 events, validates) was copied over the kept file on the mount by mistake; the kept file was restored byte for byte from the first run's mirror (cmp read back after 12 s). The rebuild is at /tmp/claude-0/work/research-af-08-e/italian-africa.mine-2026-10-24.json, not delivered. The first run's lib.py in that scratch directory was also overwritten by the resume run; the generator scripts there (ia.py, sa.py and the rest) no longer import, but the delivered JSON files are unaffected.

Because the dossiers are the first run's, their pages were opened on 2026-10-20, not in this run; the resume run re-read nine Italian Africa pages and found them consistent with the kept italian-africa on every shared date, with three gaps listed above.

union-of-south-africa slug: the af-07 dossiers (british-cape-colony, colony-of-natal, transvaal-colony, orange-river-colony) name the successor 'union-of-south-africa', which has no dossier; the state is dossier south-africa (start May 1910) and those references need re-pointing.

Overlap: south-africa is drawn from 31 May 1910 (Cliopatria begins 1932), but the british-africa dossier (af-08-b) hands the Union over to south-africa only in December 1931; that loss should be dated 31 May 1910 and British Africa's 1910-1931 Union keyframes cut, or the two overlap for 21 years. The same holds for South West Africa 1915-1931 (german-africa/british-africa).

Mirroring needed elsewhere: kingdom-of-italy (eu-13) should not count the 9 January 1939 incorporation of the Libyan coastal provinces as a gain (rename only); francoist-spain should mirror Spain's occupation of Tangier (14 June 1940 to 11 October 1945); arab-republic-of-egypt (me-10) should mirror the Halaib Triangle contest (1994-2000) and Cliopatria's 22nd-parallel shapes.

Counterparts with no dossier yet (validator warnings, not errors): transkei, bophuthatswana, venda, ciskei (south-africa); south-sudan, arab-republic-of-egypt, united-arab-republic, francoist-spain, german-africa, kingdom-of-egypt, kingdom-of-spain, libyan-arab-republic and namibia belong to other groups' lists.

Validator warnings left on purpose: republic-of-sudan has contest_start events with no later contest_end (south-sudan Abyei, rapid-support-forces 2023 and 2024) because the conflicts are ongoing at 2024; rapid-support-forces mirrors them; south-africa has 8 gazetteer unknown-region warnings (Transkei, Bophuthatswana, Venda, Ciskei) and 4 counterpart-slug warnings.
